items.title: test: repair cron retry and store retirement fixtures
items.summary: test: repair cron retry and store retirement fixtures Provide the zero-descendant registry read used during cron adapter setup. Assert the registered store-retirement operation rejects its injected write failure, then drain cleanup without changing the shared observer contract. Validation: original CI groups reproduce all three failures before the repair and pass 713 tests afterward. Both affected files pass 86 tests with one worker. Scoped static checks and independent review pass. No production or schema changes.

items.title: fix(subagents): retain committed kill counts after cleanup refusal
items.summary: fix(subagents): retain committed kill counts after cleanup refusal A descendant kill can commit before parent reactivation invalidates its remaining cleanup. Carry the run manager's publication count through that awaited tail so cancellation reports the completed kill and the cleanup error together. Keep current-authority checks and unknown-outcome refusal. Make the existing publication case hold real post-commit timing instead of polling status. The original production path deterministically reports killed:false and cascadeKilled:0; the repaired path preserves the prior child kill while leaving the successor running. Document partial counts. Validation on Node 24.21/macOS (original CI used Node 24.19/Linux): - Publication and concurrency: 23 passed; accounting: 6 passed. - Original 25-file group: 279 passed, 2 existing platform skips. - Publication file with one worker: 10 passed, 54.526s wall, 51.53s Vitest. Its real registry, lifecycle, and cleanup boundary is needed for this race; worker preparation/imports dominate, and no new test case was added. - Scoped code/docs checks and independent P2 review passed. The unchanged original-group baseline also passed locally; the controlled post-commit regression supplies the RED-to-GREEN proof.

items.title: test(ui): await owner chip typeface stylesheet loading
items.summary: test(ui): await owner chip typeface stylesheet loading The first beacon case could exhaust expect.poll's short deadline while its font stylesheet was still loading, before rendering a chip. Wait for the stylesheet's load or error event, retaining the loaded-sheet check, font readiness, and every rendering assertion. Keep existing timeouts. Linux Testbox proof: twenty complete file runs pass all 2,340 cases; three original UI shard replays pass 8,181 cases each; the whole UI config passes 24,309 cases across 1,577 files. Codex P2 review is clean. Final Linux check-changed and boundary guards passed.

items.title: test(agents): retire local command MCP fixture managers
items.summary: test(agents): retire local command MCP fixture managers A drained process singleton retained an earlier test file's lazy runtime loader, so the local-command fixture bypassed its transport mock and waited for the real transport's 30-second deadline. Drain and retire that manager in fixture setup and teardown, following the existing sibling fixtures. Keep every case and settlement assertion. The ordered real-bundle then local-command pair reproduced an empty catalog after 30,038ms before repair. Twenty complete ordered file-pair runs now pass (420 cases), followed by three full agents-core runs (8,075 passing cases each). The first broad replay fell from 372.37s with four failures to 256.60s with none. Codex P2 review is clean. Final Linux check-changed and boundary guards passed.

items.title: ShinyHunters聲稱竊得FBI資料中，包含敏感的探員個資與醫療紀錄
items.summary: 駭客組織ShinyHunters聲稱駭入美國聯邦調查局（FBI）一事再有新發現。BBC於9月24日報導，他們檢視駭客提供的外洩資料樣本後，發現其中包含FBI探員的醫療檢查紀錄，涉及血液、尿液檢測結果及醫師註記，包括高膽固醇、血尿及食物過敏等資訊，部分資料並附有探員姓名、地址、電話、徽章號碼、職務及配偶資訊。

items.title: GitHub讓AI代理接手模糊測試，可依覆蓋率自動補測未觸及程式碼
items.summary: GitHub Security Lab開源Fuzzing Taskflow，可將大型語言模型代理與AFL++模糊測試工具串成自動化管線。開發者指定C/C++專案的GitHub儲存庫後，代理會找出適合測試的函式、分析建置方式、產生模糊測試程式並執行AFL++，再依程式覆蓋率修改測試程式或測試輸入，程式崩潰分析與漏洞報告也納入流程。GitHub提醒，漏洞判斷與修補內容仍須人工審查。

items.title: 新加坡電信商Simba遭駭，逾2.3萬名用戶個資外洩
items.summary: 新加坡電信業者Simba於9月25日公告發生資料外洩事件，影響23,549名註冊該公司服務的用戶，外洩資料包括用戶姓名、身分證號碼、出生日期、手機號碼及電子郵件地址，但信用卡與銀行帳戶資料並未受到影響，目前尚無跡象顯示相關資料已被惡意濫用。

items.title: 佛州要求法院限制OpenAI開發新模型，禁止向未成年人提供ChatGPT
items.summary: 美國佛羅里達州檢察長James Uthmeier周一（9/28）向法院聲請暫時禁制令，要求OpenAI開發新AI模型時，必須先取得獨立第三方對其安全防護措施的核准，並停止向佛州未成年人提供ChatGPT。法院尚未裁定此事。
